verdict.rationale: The Guichet unique is a government company-formalities filing service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows INPI publishing an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint. The keyless JSON API probe concerns a separate state company-data API (recherche-entreprises), not an MCP server for the Guichet unique, so it does not count.
